target_semantics_lesson: Forecast the monthly broad-dollar return for the Nominal broad U.S. dollar index in December 2024.
evidence_selection_lesson: Validate causal bridges by comparing inflation data to policy projections, policy projections to futures pricing, and relative yields to capital flows.
causal_reasoning_lesson: Persistent inflation can drive a hawkish Fed policy, widening rate differentials and attracting capital, thereby supporting the dollar. Geopolitical risks can independently boost safe-haven demand.
counterevidence_lesson: Counteract dollar strength if global risk appetite broadens or other central banks become more hawkish than the Fed, diminishing rate differentials or safe-haven appeal.
calibration_lesson: Monetary policy uncertainty requires careful calibration. Unexpected shifts in inflation, Fed communication, or global conditions can alter rate differentials and dollar demand.
